//: Targets for the live smoke run (scripts/live-smoke.mjs). These go through the DEPLOYED Worker to the real internet, so they catch site changes that fixture tests cannot. Only long-lived URLs belong here — forum posts and news articles rot within weeks.
//expect_source: Which fetch path must serve the page, read from the `source:` header line. `direct` means plain HTTP worked. `perplexity` means every direct attempt was blocked and the paid site: fallback (~$0.005/call) stood in. Listing both accepts either, so a target that starts working directly does not fail the run.
//blocked: Verified 2026-08-02 from Cloudflare Worker egress: namu.wiki, sourceforge.net (including its Allura REST endpoint) and fandom.com answer 403 or a Cloudflare interstitial to every UA. Their entries therefore expect the Perplexity fallback, not a direct fetch. Wikipedia rejects the Googlebot UA but serves the desktop one, so attempt 2 succeeds.

targets.//: GitHub usually serves the Worker directly but intermittently rate-limits it, so both paths are accepted here. Steam, Cloudflare Docs and Wikipedia are the strict direct-path targets.
targets.name: github repository page

targets.//: SourceForge blocks our egress on both HTML and its Allura REST endpoint. It is readable only through the Agent API fetch_url step, so this target proves that step is alive.
targets.name: sourceforge via agent fetch_url
